name: Thomas Arturo
source:
A designer whose skill and talents have been preserved by [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Charlotte_Hansard]his sire[/url], and who has since found himself to be quite an influential figure in the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Camarilla_(VTM)]Camarilla[/url] court. 

He does not hold an official title, but having a [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Haven_(VTM)]haven[/url] planned out by this undead celebrity is a mark of status, and one that was paid with far more than exorbitant sums of money in the past.

[Edited from the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266750/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Coteries_of_New_York_Artbook/]Artbook[/url]]
